subject: Final signoff cadence and signature routing for AcmeTech MAP
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmetech.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmetech.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & signature timeline — AcmeTech

Hi Hiro / Ben —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached is the latest MAP (AcmeTech_MAP_v3.xlsx) and our procurement timeline. Two asks to keep momentum:

- Can you confirm internal approvers and the expected signature window (we typically need a 72-hour esign window for our vendors)?
- Legal needs the final SOW and an explicit start date to trigger procurement payment terms (we are aiming for a 2027-05-10 start).

If you can route DocuSign to our procurement mailbox (procurement@acmetech.com) and copy me, we should be able to complete signatures by 2027-04-29.

Attachments: AcmeTech_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP), procurement_timeline.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Product, AcmeTech

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmetech.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature timeline — AcmeTech

Tom — thanks for the MAP and timeline. Quick update from our side:

- Internal approvers: Laura (Sales Ops) will clear commercial terms, I will provide exec signoff for the pilot, and Ben will greenlight Dedicated capacity readiness.
- Proposed signature window: Redwood can do a 48-hour DocuSign window if AcmeTech can confirm that procurement can countersign by 2027-04-28 EOD PT. Shortening to 48 hrs helps lock the start date for infra provisioning.
- Start date: we can operationally commit to 2027-05-10 provided signatures complete by 2027-04-29 COB.

I've attached a short SLA summary and the commercial redline we expect to see accepted. Please confirm who should be the primary signer on your side (legal or procurement).

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf (pdf), commercial_redline.pdf (pdf)

—
Hiro Tanaka
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Quick operational note:

If we compress the eSign window to 48 hours, operations will prioritize Dedicated capacity reservation. We will need the exact start-of-day UTC for 2027-05-10 (e.g., 2027-05-10T00:00:00Z) to seed the scheduling automation. Also confirm whether the pilot needs a pre-provisioning dry-run (30m) the day before.

From my side, nothing blocks signing as long as SOW matches the MAP commitments and we get the final SLO appendix.

—

Hiro / team —

See the attached revised SOW (SOW_AcmeTech_v1.2.docx) with the delivery milestones aligned to the MAP. Procurement prefers a 72-hour review window; however, to keep to your desired cadence we can commit to a 48-hour signing window if DocuSign is initiated no later than 2027-04-27 17:00 PT and the primary signer is our VP of Ops (included in the DocuSign envelope).

Please provide the DocuSign prep link and vendor W9 / tax information for our records.

Attachments: SOW_AcmeTech_v1.2.docx (word doc)

Regards,

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acmetech.com>, procurement@acmetech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: signature routing, approvers, and kickoff gate (AC-8891)

Tom / Procurement —

This is the final go/no-go summary and routing instructions from Redwood for AC-8891. Please treat this as our single source of truth for signatures and the start date:

1) Approver roster (Redwood):
   - Laura Bennett (Sales Ops) — commercial acceptance (laura.bennett@redwood.com)
   - Hiro Tanaka — exec approval for pilot activation (hiro.tanaka@redwood.com)
   - Ben Carter — Dedicated capacity confirmation (ben.carter@redwood.com)

2) Approver roster (AcmeTech):
   - VP of Ops (primary signer) — procurement@acmetech.com will route
   - Tom Ellis (product) — acceptance of MAP milestones

3) Signature window and routing:
   - Redwood will prepare the DocuSign envelope and share the prep link by 2027-04-27 18:00 PT.
   - AcmeTech to countersign within 48 hours of envelope send (deadline: 2027-04-29 18:00 PT).
   - If countersign not complete by deadline, this reverts to a contingency window (72 hours) and start date may slip by up to one week.

4) Operational start date: 2027-05-10T00:00:00Z (Redwood will schedule provisioning to complete by this UTC timestamp once signatures are final).

5) Pre-provision dry-run: Ben will run a 30-minute connectivity check on 2027-05-09 at 15:00 PT; please confirm the engineer contact for that session.

Attachments and links: AcmeTech_MAP_v3.xlsx, Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf, SOW_AcmeTech_v1.2.docx
DocuSign prep (internal): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XYZ-AC-8891
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeMAP

Next steps (action items):
- Laura: finalize commercial redline and confirm we accept SOW_v1.2 by 2027-04-28 12:00 PT.
- Ben: confirm provisioning slot and send pre-provision invite to AcmeTech engineer by 2027-05-02.
- Tom: confirm primary signer name and email to procurement@acmetech.com and that they will be available for a 48-hour window starting when envelope is sent.

If all good, I will kick the DocuSign envelope at 18:00 PT today.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out smoothly.

—
Hiro Tanaka
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
